title: Spicy Vegan Thai Eggplant Stir-Fry
description: A flavorful and spicy stir-fry made with eggplant, Thai red curry paste, and a variety of vegetables, all vegan-friendly.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the eggplant and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the curry paste, berbere spice, and brown sugar. Cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the soy sauce, garlic, and ginger. Stir to combine.
Add the chopped basil and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 5-7 minutes, until the flavors have melded together.
Season with additional soy sauce or berbere spice to taste.
Serve over rice or noodles, garnished with additional basil if desired.
